authenticity_auditor_assessment.limitation_summary: The built-in Authenticity Auditor in src/phase1_runner.py provides strong structural and zero-fabrication guarantees, but lacks deep semantic NLP parsing to distinguish between general tax explanation boilerplate and board dividend declarations in SEC Form 497 filings.

final_assessment.reason: The 97 UNKNOWN and 0 NOT_DECLARED results are completely defensible and compliant. However, all 3 reported DECLARED cases (IVV, IWM, IEFA) were triggered by SEC Form 497 tax disclosure boilerplate and trustee equity ownership table matches rather than genuine distribution declarations.
final_assessment.next_action: Apply targeted corrections to SEC Form 497 parsing (requiring exact series/ticker headers and excluding trustee ownership tables and tax narrative descriptions) so that IVV, IWM, and IEFA correctly evaluate to UNKNOWN.
